Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:10:1.hebrew: שליחות יד - שחייבו הכתוב עליו אפילו נאנסה, כדכתיב (שמות כ״ב:י׳): "ומת או נשבר או נשבה [וגו'] שבועת ה' תהיה בין שניהם אם לא שלח ידו וגו'", דמשמע: הא שלח, נתחייב שוב במיתתה ובשבייתה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:10:1.english: Misappropriation - For which Scripture held him liable even if [the animal] suffered an unavoidable accident, as it is written (Exodus 22:10): "and it dies, or is broken, or is captured, [etc.,] an oath of the Lord shall be between the two of them, that he has not put his hand, etc." — which implies [that] if he did put [his hand], he is henceforth liable for its death or its capture.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:10:2.hebrew: צריכה חסרון - לא הוי שליחות יד להעמידה ברשותו אלא א"כ חסרה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:10:2.english: Requires loss - It is not [considered] misappropriation to place it in his [own] possession unless it suffered a loss.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:11:1.english: Does [the Mishnah] teach "he took it"? - Which implies that he took it for himself.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:11:2.hebrew: טלטלה קתני - לתשמיש בעלמא משמע, לצרכו דמתני':
Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:11:2.english: [It] teaches, "he moved it" - [This] implies for mere use — [which is the meaning of] "for his need" [in] the Mishnah.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:11:3.hebrew: אלא כגון שטלטלה להביא עליה גוזלות - לעלות עליה כדרך סולם ליטול גוזלות מקן גבוה, ואפ"ה הויא גזילה למיקם ברשותיה עד דעביד השבה, דקסבר שואל שלא מדעת בעלים גזלן הוא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:11:3.english: Rather, [a case] where he moved it to bring fledglings upon it - To climb upon it like a ladder to take fledglings from a high nest; and even so, it is [considered] robbery, so that it stands in his possession [at his liability] until he returns [it], for he holds [that] one who borrows without the owners' knowledge is a robber.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:11:4.hebrew: וכולה ר' ישמעאל היא - אשינוייא דכולהו קאי, אדר' יעקב, ואדר' נתן, ואדרב ששת:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:11:4.english: And the entire [mishna] is [in accordance with] Rabbi Yishmael - [This] refers to the resolutions of all of them: to [that of] Rabbi Yaakov, to [that of] Rabbi Natan, and to [that of] Rav Sheshet.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:11:5.hebrew: וסיפא שהניחה במקום שאינה מקומה - אבל רישא, כל מקום שהניחה מקומה היא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:11:5.english: And the latter clause [is where] he placed it in a place that is not its place - However, [in] the first clause, any place where he placed it is its [proper] place.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:12:1.hebrew: ור' יוחנן - דאמר לעיל "מאן דמתרגם לי" כו':
Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:12:1.english: And Rabbi Yochanan - who said above, "Who will explain for me," etc.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:12:2.english: “He placed it” indicates in its [designated] place - Therefore, [the mishnah] cannot be established in accordance with Rabbi Yishmael.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:13:1.hebrew: שליחות יד - שחייבו הכתוב עליו, ואפי' נאנסה, כדכתיב: "או נשבר או נשבה וגו' שבועת ה' תהיה אם לא שלח", דמשמע: הא אם שלח, נתחייב שוב במיתתה ובשבייתה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:13:1.english: Misappropriation - [That] for which Scripture made him liable, even if [the animal] suffered an unavoidable accident, as it is written: "or it be broken, or captured, etc., the oath of the Lord shall be... that he has not put [his hand]," which implies: if he did put [his hand], he is henceforth liable for its death and for its capture.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:13:2.hebrew: צריכה חסרון - וכל זמן שלא חסרה, לא קמה ברשותיה להתחייב באונסיה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:13:2.english: Requires loss - And as long as it has not suffered a loss, it has not entered into his domain to render him liable for unavoidable accidents [that befall it].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:13:3.english: A wolf - [It] tears [and] carries the prey to its lair.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:13:4.hebrew: ארי - אינו טורפה, אלא דורסה במקומה ואוכלה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:13:4.english: A lion - It does not carry it off, rather it claws it in its place and eats it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:13:5.hebrew: פטור - דאונסין נינהו. ואי משום דהניח עדרו ופשיעה היא, מוקמינן לה דעל בעידנא דעיילי אינשי, כדאמרינן בהשוכר את הפועלים (לקמן בבא מציעא צג:), א"נ דשמע קול אריה ועל:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:13:5.english: Exempt - For they are unavoidable mishaps. And if [you ask] because he left his flock and it is negligence, we establish it [as referring to a case] where he entered [the city] at the time when people [normally] enter, as we say in [the chapter entitled] HaSokher Et HaPoalim (below, Bava Metzia 93b), or else, that he heard the roar of a lion and entered.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:14:1.hebrew: הא שקלינהו - ואי נמי שליחות יד חשיבא, הא הדר אהדרה כשנטלו הימנו, ואנן מוקמינן לעיל סתם מתני' כרבי ישמעאל, דאין צריך דעת בעלים:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:14:1.english: Didn't he [already] remove them? - And even if it is considered misappropriation, behold, he returned it when he took it from it; and we established above [that] an anonymous Mishnah is in accordance with Rabbi Yishmael, that the owners' knowledge is not required.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:15:1.hebrew: הא לא משכה - בשליחות יד, כדי לקנותה. ומטלטלין אינן נקנין אלא במשיכה — לא במקח, ולא לענין גזל, ולא לענין שליחות יד, כדתנן במתני' (לקמן בבא מציעא דף מג:): הטה את החבית ונטל ממנה רביעית יין — אין משלם אלא רביעית; אלמא בעינן דליקנייה כו':
Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:15:1.english: But he did not pull it - with misappropriation, in order to acquire it. And movable property is acquired only through pulling — neither in a sale, nor with respect to robbery, nor with respect to misappropriation, as we learned in the Mishnah (below, Bava Metzia 43b): "[If] one tilted the barrel and took from it a revi'it of wine, he pays only [for] a revi'it." Thus, we require that he acquire it, etc.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:16:1.english: We read [in the text]: "And Rav Shmuel said."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:16:2.hebrew: שהכישה במקל - כשנתנו עליה ורצתה, זו היא משיכה, משעקרה יד ורגל על ידו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:16:2.english: Where he struck it with a staff - When he placed it upon it and it ran, this is [considered] pulling, since it lifted a foreleg and a hindleg through him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:16:3.hebrew: והא לא חסרה - לאו פירכא היא, אלא מסקנא וסיומא הוא למילתיה דאמר: תסתיים דרב הוא דאמר אין צריכה חסרון, מדשני רב למתניתין משום דהכישה ורצתה לפניו. ואי קשיא: דלמא הא דהניח מקלו ותרמילו, חיוביה לאו משום שליחות יד הוא דליבעי חסרון, אלא משום שואל שלא מדעת הוא, כי ההוא דלעיל דחבית? לא היא, דכי אמרינן בשומרין שאלה שלא מדעת — בדבר שאינו כיחש וחיסר מחמת מלאכה, אבל בעלי חיים המכחישים מחמת מלאכה, תחלתו שליחות יד היא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:16:3.english: But he did not cause it a loss - This is not an objection; rather, it is the conclusion and completion of his statement, as he said: Conclude that it is Rav who says [misappropriation] does not require loss, since Rav explained our Mishnah [as referring to a case] where he struck it [with a staff] and it ran before him. And if you ask: Perhaps [in] that [case of the Mishnah] where he placed his staff and pouch [upon the animal], his liability is not because of misappropriation [such] that it would require a loss, but rather because of [the law of] one who borrows without permission, like that [case] above of the barrel? [That] is not so, for when do we say "borrowing without permission" regarding bailees — [only] with respect to something that does not weaken and incur a loss as a result of work; but [regarding] living creatures, which weaken as a result of work, its very beginning is misappropriation.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:17:1.english: That he weakened it - through his striking [it], which is a loss.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:17:2.hebrew: דיקא נמי - דהכחישה קאמר רב, מדנקט הכשת מקל, דמכה חזקה היא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:17:2.english: It is also precise - that Rav meant he weakened it, since he mentioned striking with a staff, for it is a strong blow.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:18:1.english: And from [the fact] that Rav holds [that misappropriation] requires loss - For we indeed inferred [this] from [the fact] that he mentioned "a staff."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:18:2.english: Levi - His disputant holds [that misappropriation] does not require loss.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:18:3.hebrew: משונה שליחות יד כו' - כלומר, אינה דומה לזו, שזו נאמרה לצורך ולא משתמע אלא בחסרון, אבל של שומר שכר נאמרה שלא לצורך משמעות שבה, אלא לדרשה וללמד שאינה צריכה חסרון:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:18:3.english: Misappropriation [stated with regard to a paid bailee] is different, etc. - That is to say, it is not similar to that [of an unpaid bailee], for that [mention] was stated out of necessity and is only understood [to apply] with loss; whereas [that] of a paid bailee was stated not for the sake of its plain meaning, but rather for exposition and to teach that it does not require loss.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:1:1.hebrew: צריך דעת בעלים - ואם לא הודיעם, חייב באחריותם אם מת או נגנב, דמדשקליה קם ליה ברשותיה, והשבה בלא ידיעה לאו השבה היא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:1:1.english: [It] requires the knowledge of the owner - And if he did not inform them, he is liable for it if it died or was stolen, for since he took it, it stood in his domain, and a return without [their] knowledge is not [a valid] return.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:3:1.hebrew: דמקומה היא - וכיון דבאותו מקום החזירה, חזרה גמורה היא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:3:1.english: For it is its place - And since he returned it to that [same] place, it is a complete return.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:4:1.english: We arrive at [the opinion of] Rabbi Akiva - This is an answer.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:8:1.hebrew: תרגמה רבי יעקב - דתיקו כולה כחד תנא ובתרי טעמי: רישא שהחזירה למקומה, דכל מקום שהחזירה מקומה היא, דהא לא יחדו לה מקום; וסיפא שהחזירה למקום שאינה מקומה, כדמסיים במסקנא. דהא דמסקינן בסיומא "וסיפא שהניחה במקום שאינה מקומה" אתרצתא דכולהו קאי — אדר' יעקב ואדר' נתן ואדרב ששת — ומשום דהניחה חוץ למקומה לא הויא חזרה. וכגון שנטלו מתחלה על מנת לגוזלה, והיינו "לצרכו" דמתניתין. דאילו לשאלה בעלמא ולתשמיש, כיון דלאו גזילה הוא, סגי לה בהשבה כל דהו, וכל מקום שהניחה פטור באונסין; אבל משום דגזולה הואי, ובגזילה כתיב "והשיב", וזה שהניחה למקום שלא יחדו לה בעלים, לא הויא השבה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:8:1.english: Rabbi Yaakov interpreted it - So that the entire [Mishnah] stands according to one Tanna, and with two reasons: the first clause [is a case] where he returned it to its place, for any place where he returned it is its place, since they did not designate a place for it; and the latter clause [is a case] where he returned it to a place that is not its place, as it concludes at the end [of the statement]. For that which we conclude at the end, "and the latter clause [is] where he placed it in a place that is not its place," refers to the answers of all of them — Rabbi Yaakov, Rabbi Natan, and Rav Sheshet — and because he placed it outside its place, it is not [considered] a return. And [this is] a case where he took it initially in order to rob it, and that is [the meaning of] "for his own need" in our Mishnah. For if [he had taken it] merely to borrow and for use, since it is not robbery, any return whatsoever would suffice for it, and [in] whatever place he put it down, he would be exempt from unavoidable accidents; however, because it was stolen, and regarding robbery it is written "and he shall return [the stolen object]," and this [bailee] put it down in a place that the owners did not designate for it, it is not [considered] a return.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:9:1.hebrew: ור' נתן תרגמה - דאפילו לא נטלה על מנת לגוזלה כו', אלא על מנת לשלוח בה יד וליטול מקצתה, ולא נטל, אפ"ה קמה ליה ברשותיה כולה והויא לה גזילה ובעי' השבה, ובמקום שאינו מקומה לאו השבה היא. ורב ששת לא שביק דליסיימו לתירוצייהו, ואתקיף: מידי נטלה קתני כו'. ומיהו סיומא דמילתא דמסקנא: וסיפא שהניחה במקום שאינו מקומה — אכולהו קאי:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 41a:9:1.english: And Rabbi Natan interpreted it - [He holds] that even if he did not take it in order to rob [the owner of] it, etc., but rather in order to misappropriate it and take a portion of it, and he did not [actually] take [any], even so, the entire [barrel] stands in his possession and becomes a robbed item, and requires returning; and [putting it] in a place that is not its [designated] place is not [considered] returning [it]. And Rav Sheshet did not allow them to finish their explanations, and objected: "Does [the Mishnah] teach that he took it," etc.? However, the conclusion of the statement in the final resolution — "and the latter clause [is where] he placed it in a place that is not its [designated] place" — applies to all of them.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 41a:13:1.hebrew: ובא זאב וטרף - בשעת משלחת זאבים; ורבי יהודה היא דאמר זאב אחד אונס בפ' הפועלים (לקמן בבא מציעא דף צג:):
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 41a:13:1.english: "And a wolf came and devoured" - [This refers to] a time of a plague of wolves; and it is [the view of] Rabbi Yehudah, who says that a single wolf is [considered] an unavoidable accident, in the chapter [entitled] HaPo'alim (below, Bava Metzia 93b):

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 41a:14:1.hebrew: הא שקלינהו - לרבי ישמעאל פריך, דאמר לא בעינן דעת בעלים, כפרש"י:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 41a:14:1.english: "Didn't he remove them?" - [The Gemara] is raising an objection according to Rabbi Yishmael, who says [that] we do not require the owners' knowledge, as Rashi explained:

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 41a:15:1.hebrew: הא לא משכה - דאע"ג דעודן עליה, לא קיימא ברשותיה להתחייב באונסיה עד שימשוך, כדאמר במתני' (לקמן בבא מציעא דף מג:): "הטה את החבית ונטל ממנה רביעית, אינו חייב אלא דמי רביעית, כיון דלא הגביה את החבית". ומשני: שהניח מקלו ותרמילו עליה כל כך בחוזק עד שרצתה לפניו:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 41a:15:1.english: "But he did not pull it" - For even though they [i.e., the staff and satchel] are still on it, it is not in his possession to become liable for unavoidable accidents [befalling] it until he pulls [it], as it states in the Mishnah (later, Bava Metzia 43b): "If one tilted a barrel and took a revi'it from it, he is liable only for the value of a revi'it, since he did not lift the barrel." And [the Gemara] answers: [It is a case] where he placed his staff and his satchel upon it with such force that it ran before him.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 41a:17:1.hebrew: דיקא נמי דקתני שהכישה - וא"ת: בפ"ק דקדושין (דף כב:) תניא: "או שהכישה במקל ורצתה לפניו", דאקרי משיכה, ולא הויא הכחשה? וי"ל: דהתם, דאדם נכרי לקחה ואינה מכירתו בדבורו, שייך למיתני "הכישה"; אבל הכא, דאיירי ברועה שהבהמה מכירתו ואזלה מחמת דבורו, לא שייך למיתני "שהכישה":
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 41a:17:1.english: "[His language] is also precise, as he teaches: Where he struck it" - And if you ask: In the first chapter of Kiddushin (22b), it is taught [in a baraita]: "Or if he struck it with a staff and it ran before him," which is called meshikhah [pulling], and it is not [considered] weakening? And one can answer: There, where a stranger took it and it does not recognize him by his voice, it is appropriate to teach "struck it"; but here, where [it] is speaking of a shepherd, whom the animal recognizes and goes on account of his voice, it is not appropriate to teach "where he struck it."

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 41a:2:1.hebrew: אי רבי ישמעאל אפילו יחדו נמי - וא"ת: מנ"ל? י"ל: מדנקט טלה וסלע — דסתם טלה לא יחד לו מקום, אלא הולך ממרעה למרעה, וסתם סלע יחדו לו מקום בכיס, וגם כיס יחדו לו מקום בתיבה; ולכך פריך נמי בסמוך לר"ע: "אפילו לא יחדו נמי":
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 41a:2:1.english: "If [it is according to] Rabbi Yishmael ... even [if] they designated [a place] as well" - And if you ask: From where do we know [this]? One can say: Since [the baraita] uses [the cases of] a lamb and a sela — for [with] an ordinary lamb, one did not designate a place for it, rather it goes from pasture to pasture, whereas [with] an ordinary sela, they designated a place for it in a purse, and also [for] a purse, they designated a place for it in a chest — and therefore [the Gemara] also asks shortly [regarding] Rabbi Akiva: "even [if] they did not designate [a place] as well."

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 41a:8:1.hebrew: שנטלה והגביהה ע"מ לגוזלה כו' - והיינו חסרון, שהכל גוזל ונטל לצורך עצמו:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 41a:8:1.english: "Where he took it and lifted it in order to steal it," etc. - And this constitutes a diminution [of the deposit], because he is stealing the entire [barrel] and taking [it] for his own use.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 41a:9:1.hebrew: שנטלה ע"מ לשלוח בה יד - פי': ליטול מקצת; אע"פ שלא נטל אותה מקצת, חייב בכולה, כדאמר בשלהי פרקין (דף מד.): "לא נטל נטל ממש, אלא כיון שהגביה ליטול, אע"פ שלא נטל". אבל למ"ד ע"מ לגוזלה, דבעי חסרון, אם הגביה ליטול קצת, אינו חייב עד שיטול המקצת, כיון דבעי חסרון. וקשה, דבשלהי פרקין קאמר: אפי' למ"ד בעי חסרון, מודה בחבית — אם הגביהה, אע"פ שלא נטל, חייב, דניחא ליה דתיהוי כולה בסיס להאי רביעית — ומתני' בחבית איירי! ויש לומר דמתני' איירי אפילו בשמן, דלא מנטר פורתא אגב האחר:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 41a:9:1.english: Where he took it in order to misappropriate it - Explanation: [meaning] to take a part [of it]; even though he has not [yet] taken that part, he is liable for the entire [barrel], as [the Gemara] says at the end of our chapter (44a): "[The phrase] 'he took' does not [mean] he actually took [it], rather, once he lifted [it] to take [some], even though he did not [yet] take [it]." However, according to the one who says [that the Mishnah refers to taking it] in order to steal it — which requires diminution — if he lifted [it] to take a small amount, he is not liable until he takes the part, since [that view] requires diminution. And this is difficult, for at the end of our chapter [the Gemara] says: Even according to the one who says it requires diminution, he concedes regarding a barrel [that] if he lifted it, even though he did not take [any], he is liable, because it is pleasing to him that the entire [barrel] should serve as a base for this revi'it — and our Mishnah is dealing with a barrel! And one can say that our Mishnah is dealing even with oil, where a small amount is not preserved along with the rest.
